title: Agent chat P2: tool bridge — auto-generate AI SDK tools from agent-protocol Zod schemas -> dispatchAgentCommand
description: Build the tool bridge so the in-browser LLM drives Dash via the SAME layer as MCP. Depends on P1 (ai@^6 installed). The codebase already exposes: dispatchAgentCommand(command, params) in packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts (transport-agnostic, applies a tool call to the live document), and 72+ commands as Zod schemas in packages/agent-protocol (ALL_COMMANDS, each with {Command}ParamsSchema). (1) Create packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/tools.ts that builds an AI SDK v6 tool set: for each command in the agent-protocol registry, tool({ description: from the command's description/name, inputSchema: the command's Zod params schema, execute: async (args) => dispatchAgentCommand(commandName, args) }). Map every command generically (no per-tool hand-coding); include the result JSON as the tool result. (2) An 'editor ready' guard: if setAgentCallbacks hasn't run, tools return an actionable 'editor not ready' error rather than throwing. (3) A system prompt module describing Dash (a Flash 8 authoring tool), the document model basics, and that the assistant drives it via these tools; concise + effective. (4) Optionally curate: exclude any command unsuitable for the chat (none expected; document if so). VERIFY: build green; unit test that the generated tool set covers ALL_COMMANDS, that a sample tool's execute calls dispatchAgentCommand with the right name/args (mock the registry), and inputSchema matches the Zod schema. Acceptable failures: only ~3 task-1207 fixtures. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry. Scope: new agentchat/tools.ts + system-prompt file (+ read agent-protocol/registry).
